scope: Local website audit and verification; existing application source was not edited by this audit.

connectivity.initialPage: Cached generic offline shell; no listeners on ports 3000, 3001 or 55432.
connectivity.recovery: Started the existing local synthetic PostgreSQL/PostGIS and web/API scripts, then reloaded the tab.
connectivity.livePage: Synthetic sign-in and authenticated workspace rendered successfully.
connectivity.applicationChanges: None by this audit. The earlier implementation chat was actively changing source during the first test run.

checks.name: Frozen contracts and generated API types
checks.detail: 170 operations, 169 schemas and event envelope checked; repeated after current changes.

checks.name: Biome formatting/lint
checks.detail: Final check: 74 files. Initial formatting failures were corrected by other active implementation owners.

checks.name: Vitest unit/integration
checks.detail: Final run: 148 tests in 15 files, 34.10 seconds. Initial run: 130 tests in 12 files. Real local PostgreSQL roles used.

checks.name: Initial desktop/mobile E2E
checks.detail: 12 tests: 3 passed, 9 failed, 4.7 minutes. Source changed during this run; see individual classifications.

checks.name: Focused offline/update E2E rerun
checks.detail: 6 tests: 4 passed, 2 failed. Offline draft and waiting-worker tests passed on both desktop and 360px. Logout/offline-shell test failed on both; desktop selector ambiguity, mobile shell assertion.

checks.name: Manual 360px workflow
checks.detail: Synthetic sign-in, contact/lead creation, linked follow-up creation and completion, lead stage update to Attempted Contact with revision v2, and owner organization switch removing earlier records.

checks.name: Manual layout
checks.detail: Settings: content width 360 at viewport 360. Pipeline: content width 345 at viewport 360. Dashboard inspected at 1440x900 and 1280x720; short desktop sidebar overflow reproduced.

checks.name: Full accessibility acceptance
checks.detail: Mobile keyboard/axe test passed in the initial run. Desktop axe reported color contrast; sidebar geometry reproduced separately. Other states remain gated by failing tests.

failed.evidence: Exact getByLabel('Intent') did not resolve the wrapped select. Manual getByRole('combobox', {name:'Intent'}) succeeded. Downstream interruption acceptance was not reached.
Runtime ReferenceError: FileSpreadsheetIcon was not defined. Current source imports FileSpreadsheet and Contacts now renders.
Test asks for exact Organization; rendered mobile control is Mobile organization. Manual switching succeeded.
First run remained at Opening your workspace during active source changes. Focused rerun passed.
Two visible Sign out buttons match the unscoped strict locator. Cache and IndexedDB assertions passed before this failure.
Synthetic member text was below the fixed sidebar; axe reported 1.92:1 against the light body background.
After context.setOffline(true) and navigation, Opening your workspace remained instead of the generic offline shell. Reproduced in focused rerun.
Synthetic sign-in returned an ambiguous network failure during source changes. Focused rerun passed.

findings.title: Short desktop sidebar places profile and sign-out below the viewport
findings.evidence: At 1280x720 the sidebar ends at y=720 with overflow-y:visible; the Synthetic member label spans y=722.67 to 738.67. The 1440x900 view contains the profile. Axe reports contrast 1.92:1 when the text spills onto the light body background.
findings.nextAction: Make the sidebar fit or scroll at short viewport heights, keep sign-out reachable, then rerun desktop axe and keyboard checks.

findings.title: Authored E2E selectors prevent several acceptance workflows from executing
findings.evidence: Exact Intent label lookup fails; mobile organization has another accessible name; desktop Sign out resolves to two buttons. The desktop Tasks badge also changes its accessible name to Tasks 1, while navigate() asks for exact Tasks.
findings.nextAction: Use rendered role/name controls and scoped navigation/logout selectors; retain behavior assertions and rerun both projects. Do not suppress axe violations.

findings.title: Mobile offline navigation after logout does not reach the generic shell in the harness
findings.evidence: Repeated context.setOffline(true) /contacts navigation leaves Opening your workspace. Saved trace contains an HTTP 200 text/html response for /contacts with Cache-Control:no-store. Safe CacheStorage and empty IndexedDB assertions passed before navigation; no private-data leak was observed.
findings.nextAction: Determine whether offline emulation applies to the service-worker network request and reproduce with a controlled network failure. Keep the offline cold-start acceptance gate open until the generic shell is proven.

findings.title: Next.js development indicator overlaps the mobile Dashboard control
findings.evidence: At 360x800, pointer activation of the Dashboard link opened the Next.js Dev Tools menu. Keyboard Enter reached /dashboard.
findings.nextAction: Position the development indicator away from mobile navigation or use an isolated production preview for acceptance.

limits: No milestone or production-readiness gate is marked complete by this audit.
Physical iPhone/Android installed modes, real OIDC, Redis recovery, live Trestle, real messages/payments, production deployment, load/recovery and isolated CI were not tested.
No existing application source was edited by this audit. Source was changing in the earlier implementation chat; a stable full browser rerun remains necessary.
The local synthetic web/API/PostgreSQL services were left running and the @Browser app tab was kept open; temporary viewport overrides were reset.
